verdict.rationale: Online filing without first creating an account is a fair question for an immigration agency's online services, so the axis applies. The only evidence item is a TLS connection failure on robots.txt, and nothing on the host was fetched. No published page documenting a keyless or file-number entry path is in evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
